document_content.description: Text content of threat model or tabletop minutes (analyze_document action).

source_type.description: Where the scenario came from. 'actor_projection' marks a scenario imported from adversary_path_projector, so projected scenarios stay distinguishable from analyst-built ones.

scenario_id.description: Scenario ID for add_control, add_event, gap_analysis, export, export_scenario. Omit for export_scenario to export every scenario.

tactic.description: ATT&CK tactic the event claims (add_event). Optional.

evidence.description: How strongly the actor-to-technique claim is sourced, e.g. 'documented' or 'via_software' as adversary_path_projector sets it (add_event). Optional.

artifact_id.description: json_events artifact to import (import_scenario): an adversary_path_projector scenario seed, or a saved export_scenario result.

file_path.description: Path to a scenario document to import (import_scenario). Injected by the shell when 'artifact_id' is given.

path_id.description: Import only this projected path (import_scenario). Omit to import each path, up to 'max_paths'.

max_paths.description: Most scenarios one import creates (import_scenario). Each path becomes a scenario an analyst has to review; paths over the limit are reported by id, not imported.
